redFirst.basis: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/affected.py` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 on "NameError: name 'reach_graph' is not defined" (read as python), and the task introduces 'reach_graph': absent from HEAD's tools/measure-affected-miss.py, tools/affected.py and present in the working tree's tools/affected.py; a second run with the working tree's implementation copied in exited 0 without that error, its tests reaching their assertions; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop; fix run: held back 21s of the deadline, the recorded slot-seconds of tools/affected.py in .github/sweep-costs.json

outcome.technical: tools/affected.py: the hand-kept TREE_SCANNERS tuple, the `.py -> test__output.py` mapping, the shipped-only `_deps.import_graph()` closure and the regex `_suites_importing()` are replaced by reach_graph(): one AST walk per `.py` under scripts/, hooks/, tests/ and tools/ records imports, `_loader` load/load_script/script_path and hooks `_config.find_script` calls read through the module alias (wrapper call sites included, module-level `NAME = "x.py"` constants resolved), and - for development code only (tests/, tools/) - every `.py` literal inside a call (subprocess argv, os.path.join of a read source). A computed resolver target in dev code reads as every scripts/ module. reached_by() closes the reverse walk transitively; a suite is a sink except through an import of it. Tree scanners are derived: functions in _output.py and tools/lints/ that reach os.walk (fixpoint), and every suite/tool calling one through that module; any changed `.py` selects them. select(paths, graph=None) builds the graph once per call when a `.py` is present; _cases build it once. Tools reached get `python3 <tool> --selftest` gates. A tests/ helper (e.g. _harness.py) is no longer added as a suite named after itself. New cases a18a..a18m (one per measured commit, data inline: commit, changed files, missed suites), a18z (the two missed suites the tree retired stay retired), a19 (leaf narrows). a16/a17 now use the leaf module because _output.py is reached by every suite. tools/measure-affected-miss.py: CLI kept; new `--selector FILE` writes that selector over the scratch tree's tools/affected.py for the selection only and restores the commit's own copy (or removes it) before anything is mutated or swept, so one selector can be measured across history; cases m19, m19b. Runs: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/affected.py` exit 0 (41 cases); dependants subset `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/affected.py tools/measure-affected-miss.py tests/test__gate_derive.py tests/test_derive_phase_gate.py tests/test__refs.py tests/test__output_lints.py tests/test__deps.py tools/gate-parity.py tools/bench-hooks.py` exit 0, 9/9 files ok, 984 cases; ruff and vermin -t=3.8- clean on both files. Leaf-module selection (plugins/audit/scripts/governance/record-outside-run.py): before 12 of 164 suites and NOT its own suite; after 24 of 164 suites (`tools/affected.py --list-related <leaf> | wc -l`) plus 14 tool selftest gates, full=False. Dropped from the .py selection because no shared walk reaches them: test__config_rules, test__manifest_rules, test__report_page, test__ui_theme (raw os.walk for def names only), test_remind_tdd, test_validate_manifest - the re-measurement should watch these. Selector wall time ~5s, measured back to back once (old `_deps.import_graph()` ~5.2s the same way).
outcome.descriptive: The affected selection now selects every suite the 2026-10-25 miss measurement recorded, derived from the code's imports, loads, runs and shared tree walks, while a leaf module still narrows.
